topic_title: The Church Armenia Put on Trial

slides.headline: Armenia Just Put Its Church on Trial
slides.body: A Prime Minister ordered the head of a 1,700-year-old church into a courtroom. This is not ancient history. This is this month.

slides.headline: A Church Older Than the State
slides.body: The Armenian Apostolic Church has led the nation since 301 AD. Prime Minister Nikol Pashinyan has fought it since 2024.

slides.headline: Now Its Leader Faces Prison
slides.body: Karekin II and six bishops went on trial August 7. One archbishop is already serving two years. Another was arrested for plotting a coup.

slides.headline: Twelve Clergy Arrested in One Sweep
slides.body: Authorities arrested a bishop and twelve clergymen this year. The Council of Europe assembly called it deep concern over Church repression.

slides.headline: Courts Become Weapons Against Dissent
slides.body: Defrock a bishop, jail an archbishop, charge a third with plotting a coup - the law bends however power needs, right before an election.

slides.headline: Church or State - Who Answers to Whom?
slides.body: Armenia votes in 2026. Is this justice for a defrocked bishop, or a government silencing the one institution that can still move a crowd?
